notes: 0.153.0 verified live 2026-09-04 against a real ChatGPT-subscription install: workspace-write completed one direct and two orchestrated BENCH-09 tasks, each with passing scope, gate, and hidden oracle evaluation.
The verified Windows host uses the documented windows.sandbox=unelevated fallback because its elevated sandbox setup fails to launch child commands; danger-full-access is not used.

The adapter intentionally keeps user config/rules loading. On CLI 0.147.0, --ignore-user-config caused the generated managed permission profile to become read-only despite a later --sandbox workspace-write flag.
The codex binary is not always a global PATH install - on at least one verified machine it ships bundled inside the VS Code openai.chatgpt extension.
Usage is read from the token_count event's total_token_usage in the --json JSONL stream (cumulative, not per-turn) - see src/engines/codex-cli.ts parseCodexUsage().
2.1.177 verified live: doctor PASS, a real isolated single-task run committed and gated successfully.

--bare mode is opt-in only (bareMode: false by default) - it skips OAuth/keychain auth and requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, the wrong default for a worker meant to authenticate the same way an interactive session on the machine already does.

--json-schema is advertised by `claude -p --help` but hangs indefinitely at runtime regardless of auth state or --output-format (verified live) - not required or used; structured output is enforced by prompt instruction plus client-side schema validation instead.

Usage is read from the top-level usage object (input_tokens/cache_creation_input_tokens/cache_read_input_tokens/output_tokens) plus total_cost_usd in the --output-format json envelope - see src/engines/claude-cli.ts parseClaudeUsage().
No account-level %5h/%weekly usage percentage is available from any local CLI output or transcript - confirmed live (`claude -p "/usage"` does not intercept the slash command).
